keyHighlights.title: Kasba Peth Infrastructure & Traffic Management
keyHighlights.description: Kunal is actively advancing key infrastructure projects in Kasba Peth. He plays a pivotal role in expediting approvals for flyovers, road widening, and parking management.

keyHighlights.title: Education - NaMo Vidyanidhi Scholarships
keyHighlights.description: Through the NaMo Vidyanidhi initiative, hundreds of deserving students in Kasba Peth receive direct financial scholarships to pursue their academic dreams.

keyHighlights.title: Healthcare - Free Medical & Teleconsultation Drives
keyHighlights.description: Regular health camps, free diagnostic drives, and generic medicine centers set up across the constituency to support senior citizens and families.

parliamentItems.title: Intervention on Urban Mobility & Traffic Infrastructure

constituencyProjects.title: SWAMIH Funds for Housing Completion
constituencyProjects.description: Facilitated funding support for key residential housing projects to ensure construction resumption and timely delivery for citizens.

constituencyProjects.title: Accessible Public Places & Wheelchair Ramps

constituencyProjects.title: Public School Modernization & Cleanliness Drives
constituencyProjects.description: Upgraded digital classrooms, science labs, and sanitation infrastructure across municipal schools.
